核对牵绳区域、部分离绳条件、禁犬地点和粪便清理规则。: Check leash areas, conditional off-leash access, dog-free areas, and waste cleanup rules.

核对 Crissy Field、Baker Beach 等具体沿海地段的犬只规则: Check dog-rule maps for specific coastal areas such as Crissy Field and Baker Beach.
第一次带狗到陌生公园，最实用的计划是先做一段牵绳短程散步，看看环境和狗的反应。别: For a first dog visit to an unfamiliar park, start with a short leashed walk and see how the setting and your dog feel. Another person letting a dog off leash doesn't mean it's allowed where you are. Parking lots, lawns, creeks, and beaches within one park may have different rules. Identify the managing agency and the exact route before deciding how far to go.
先找到“这段路归谁管”: First ask who manages this stretch of path
东湾区域公园先查 EBRPD Dogs 总页，再打开目标公园地图；总页并不表示所: For East Bay regional parks, start with EBRPD's Dogs page, then open the specific park map. The general page does not mean every park has the same rules. In the Presidio, distinguish jurisdictions: the Trust manages most inland areas, while NPS manages coastal areas including Baker Beach and Crissy Field. Connected green spaces on a map do not necessarily share off-leash rules.
把预计走的起点、转折点和终点写下来，再逐段查是否允许犬只、是否牵绳及当期关闭。P: Write down your start, turns, and endpoint, then check dog access, leash rules, and current closures for each section. Presidio has seasonal protections, so use the current map and signs rather than last year's experience. If you can't find clear information, ask the manager; not seeing a sign doesn't mean access is allowed.
从下车开始牵好，不等进入步道才处理: Leash up when leaving the car, not when you reach the trail
EBRPD 要求停车场、野餐区、草坪等开发区域、放牧动物所在处及指定地段使用不超: EBRPD requires leashes no longer than six feet in developed areas such as parking lots, picnic areas, and lawns, around grazing animals, and in designated sections. Entrance areas also have leash boundaries. Some undeveloped areas allow controlled off-leash access, but they're not a place to teach recall for the first time. Let your dog settle somewhere quiet before entering crowded or narrow spaces.
Presidio Trust 的多数可带狗区域要求牵绳，West Pacific: Most dog-friendly areas managed by the Presidio Trust require leashes. Only a limited, specifically marked area near West Pacific Avenue allows voice control. This is not permission to treat the entire park as a dog park; playgrounds, sports fields, and sensitive natural areas may prohibit pets. Shorten your dog's range before crossings or approaching children or other dogs, and ask the other owner before greeting.
想去 Crissy Field，打开分区地图再决定: Heading to Crissy Field? Open the zone map first
NPS 的管理规定附有 Crissy Field 东西区与 Baker Beac: NPS rules include maps for east and west Crissy Field, Baker Beach, and other locations, with different leash, voice-control, and exclusion rules by area. Pets cannot enter Crissy Field's tidal marsh or lagoon—not even to retrieve a ball or swim. Treat these boundaries as places to avoid, rather than following what others do on arrival.
在明确允许声控的地方，声控也不是“平时听话”：NPS 要求犬只在主人视听范围内，: Where voice control is explicitly allowed, it means more than “usually well-behaved.” NPS requires dogs to remain within their owner's sight and hearing, return immediately when called, and be able to be leashed. If your dog is overexcited, anxious, or likely to chase wildlife, keep the leash on or leave early. Friends joining the walk do not take over the owner's responsibility for control.
出门包不大，责任要带齐: A small outing bag, with all your responsibilities covered
确认牵绳、胸背或项圈牢靠，带水、便携碗和足量拾便袋。: Check that the leash, harness, or collar is secure. Bring water, a portable bowl, and enough waste bags.
保存官方路段地图与当期关闭提示；先选能原路返回的短线。: Save the official route map and current closure notices. Start with a short route you can retrace.
同行前说明狗的体型、是否习惯其他犬只以及希望保持的距离。: Before meeting up, describe your dog's size, comfort around other dogs, and preferred distance.
粪便装袋后立即投入允许的垃圾桶或带走，不留在路边等回程再取。: Put bagged waste in an allowed trash bin immediately or carry it out. Don't leave it beside the path to collect on the way back.
遇野生动物、放牧动物或狗持续紧张时拉开距离，不追赶、不投喂。: Create distance from wildlife, grazing animals, or anything that keeps your dog stressed. Don't chase or feed animals.
第一次的结束标准，是大家还有余力: End the first outing while everyone still has energy
出门前和同行者约好折返点，休息时让狗喝水，别用完成某个里程来衡量这次是否值得。回: Agree on a turnaround point with companions before leaving, offer water during breaks, and don't judge the outing by mileage. On return, check your belongings and any mud or sand that needs cleaning, then note which sections worked and which to avoid. Extending a previously checked route next time is easier than entering several areas with different rules at once.
约一次全程牵绳的短途遛狗: Plan a short, fully leashed dog walk
写清公园、已核对的路段、集合点、狗的情况和互动偏好；陌生犬只见面先留距离，不默认: Specify the park, checked trail sections, meeting point, your dog's situation, and interaction preferences. Give unfamiliar dogs space at first; don't assume they can be let loose to play together.
